Levi's 501 Taper Women's NWT in gray/black stretch. It's a modern, common style, so it won't draw the vintage premium. New-condition comps run $50–75, but those are selvedge, premium or STF pieces. NWT 501 Taper retails around $70–80, and resale on eBay is probably $30–45. My best guess is about typical, around $40.
